You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

Period kinds match the main parser: day, today, yesterday, last_n_days, week_this,
week_last, month, month_this, month_last, quarter, year, ytd, range, tet,
before_tet. Copy written numbers; never invent calendar dates for relative words.

Metrics (the only ones in scope):
- revenue: money from orders that are completed or shipping, excluding cancelled
  orders and any order that has a return. Sum of line amounts in the period.
- order_count: number of those same orders (not cancelled, not returned).
- cancel_count: number of cancelled orders.
- cancel_rate: cancelled orders divided by all orders placed in the period, times 100.
- avg_order_value: revenue divided by order_count.
- revenue_share: revenue of the filtered part divided by revenue of the whole shop
  in the same period, times 100. Walk-in customers stay in the denominator.

Kinds:
- value: one number for one period.
- compare: two numbers. op is pct_change ((asked - baseline) / baseline * 100) or
  diff (asked - baseline). compare_kind says how to get the baseline.
- series: the same metric over each listed period, in that order.
- multi: the same metric and period, once per entry in multi_filters.
- trend: whether the metric is increasing or decreasing across the periods.
- argmax: the day or month with the max or min value. Ties go to the earliest date.

Period kinds. Copy numbers that are written in the question. For relative wording,
use the kind or year_rel. Never turn 'tháng này', 'tuần rồi', 'năm ngoái', or
'Tết năm nay' into calendar dates.
- day: an explicit calendar date. Example: ngày 3/3/2024 -> date 2024-03-03.
- today: hôm nay.
- yesterday: hôm qua.
- last_n_days: 7 ngày gần nhất -> n=7, including today.
- week_this: tuần này, Monday through today.
- week_last: tuần rồi / tuần trước, the previous Monday-Sunday week.
- month: tháng 5/2025 -> month=5, year=2025. tháng 5 with no year -> year null.
- month_this: tháng này, day 1 through today.
- month_last: the whole previous calendar month, not the same-day-count comparison.
- quarter: quý 3 with no year -> q=3, year null. quý 3/2024 -> q=3, year=2024.
- year: năm 2024 -> year=2024. năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. năm nay -> year_rel=0.
- ytd: từ đầu năm đến hôm nay.
- range: both endpoints are written as calendar dates.
- tet: Tết năm nay -> year_rel=0. Tết năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. Tết 2024 -> year=2024.
- before_tet: 17 ngày trước Tết năm nay -> n_days=17, year_rel=0.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent

  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.

  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

Period kinds match the main parser: day, today, yesterday, last_n_days, week_this,
week_last, month, month_this, month_last, quarter, year, ytd, range, tet,
before_tet. Copy written numbers; never invent calendar dates for relative words.

message. Leave unused fields null. active_ingredient, unit, employee and
customer are free text copied from the question when needed.

Metrics (the only ones in scope):
- revenue: money from orders that are completed or shipping, excluding cancelled
  orders and any order that has a return. Sum of line amounts in the period.
- order_count: number of those same orders (not cancelled, not returned).
- cancel_count: number of cancelled orders.
- cancel_rate: cancelled orders divided by all orders placed in the period, times 100.
- avg_order_value: revenue divided by order_count.
- revenue_share: revenue of the filtered part divided by revenue of the whole shop
  in the same period, times 100. Walk-in customers stay in the denominator.

Kinds:
- value: one number for one period.
- compare: two numbers. op is pct_change ((asked - baseline) / baseline * 100) or
  diff (asked - baseline). compare_kind says how to get the baseline.
- series: the same metric over each listed period, in that order.
- multi: the same metric and period, once per entry in multi_filters.
- trend: whether the metric is increasing or decreasing across the periods.
- argmax: the day or month with the max or min value. Ties go to the earliest date.

Period kinds. Copy numbers that are written in the question. For relative wording,
use the kind or year_rel. Never turn 'tháng này', 'tuần rồi', 'năm ngoái', or
'Tết năm nay' into calendar dates.
- day: an explicit calendar date. Example: ngày 3/3/2024 -> date 2024-03-03.
- today: hôm nay.
- yesterday: hôm qua.
- last_n_days: 7 ngày gần nhất -> n=7, including today.
- week_this: tuần này, Monday through today.
- week_last: tuần rồi / tuần trước, the previous Monday-Sunday week.
- month: tháng 5/2025 -> month=5, year=2025. tháng 5 with no year -> year null.
- month_this: tháng này, day 1 through today.
- month_last: the whole previous calendar month, not the same-day-count comparison.
- quarter: quý 3 with no year -> q=3, year null. quý 3/2024 -> q=3, year=2024.
- year: năm 2024 -> year=2024. năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. năm nay -> year_rel=0.
- ytd: từ đầu năm đến hôm nay.
- range: both endpoints are written as calendar dates.
- tet: Tết năm nay -> year_rel=0. Tết năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. Tết 2024 -> year=2024.
- before_tet: 17 ngày trước Tết năm nay -> n_days=17, year_rel=0.

compare_kind:
- explicit: the question names both periods. Asked period first, baseline second.
- previous_period: so với kỳ trước, or tháng trước cùng số ngày. One period only.
- same_period_last_year: cùng kỳ năm ngoái. One period only.
- before_tet_same_length: same number of days immediately before Tết. One period only.
- null: not a period comparison. Use filters_b when both sides share a period but
  use different filters, such as ca chiều versus ca sáng. filters is the asked side
  and filters_b is the baseline.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

Period kinds match the main parser: day, today, yesterday, last_n_days, week_this,
week_last, month, month_this, month_last, quarter, year, ytd, range, tet,
before_tet. Copy written numbers; never invent calendar dates for relative words.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.

  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.

- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date

- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.

Metrics (the only ones in scope):

- order_count: number of those same orders (not cancelled, not returned).
- cancel_count: number of cancelled orders.
- cancel_rate: cancelled orders divided by all orders placed in the period, times 100.
- avg_order_value: revenue divided by order_count.
- revenue_share: revenue of the filtered part divided by revenue of the whole shop

Kinds:
- value: one number for one period.
- compare: two numbers. op is pct_change ((asked - baseline) / baseline * 100) or
  diff (asked - baseline). compare_kind says how to get the baseline.
- series: the same metric over each listed period, in that order.
- multi: the same metric and period, once per entry in multi_filters.
- trend: whether the metric is increasing or decreasing across the periods.
- argmax: the day or month with the max or min value. Ties go to the earliest date.

use the kind or year_rel. Never turn 'tháng này', 'tuần rồi', 'năm ngoái', or

- yesterday: hôm qua.
- last_n_days: 7 ngày gần nhất -> n=7, including today.
- week_this: tuần này, Monday through today.
- week_last: tuần rồi / tuần trước, the previous Monday-Sunday week.
- month: tháng 5/2025 -> month=5, year=2025. tháng 5 with no year -> year null.
- month_this: tháng này, day 1 through today.
- month_last: the whole previous calendar month, not the same-day-count comparison.
- quarter: quý 3 with no year -> q=3, year null. quý 3/2024 -> q=3, year=2024.
- year: năm 2024 -> year=2024. năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. năm nay -> year_rel=0.
- ytd: từ đầu năm đến hôm nay.
- range: both endpoints are written as calendar dates.
- tet: Tết năm nay -> year_rel=0. Tết năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. Tết 2024 -> year=2024.
- before_tet: 17 ngày trước Tết năm nay -> n_days=17, year_rel=0.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

Period kinds match the main parser: day, today, yesterday, last_n_days, week_this,
week_last, month, month_this, month_last, quarter, year, ytd, range, tet,
before_tet. Copy written numbers; never invent calendar dates for relative words.

- yesterday: hôm qua.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

Period kinds match the main parser: day, today, yesterday, last_n_days, week_this,
week_last, month, month_this, month_last, quarter, year, ytd, range, tet,
before_tet. Copy written numbers; never invent calendar dates for relative words.

message. Leave unused fields null. active_ingredient, unit, employee and
customer are free text copied from the question when needed.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

before_tet. Copy written numbers; never invent calendar dates for relative words.

Metrics (the only ones in scope):
- revenue: money from orders that are completed or shipping, excluding cancelled
  orders and any order that has a return. Sum of line amounts in the period.
- order_count: number of those same orders (not cancelled, not returned).
- cancel_count: number of cancelled orders.
- cancel_rate: cancelled orders divided by all orders placed in the period, times 100.
- avg_order_value: revenue divided by order_count.
- revenue_share: revenue of the filtered part divided by revenue of the whole shop
  in the same period, times 100. Walk-in customers stay in the denominator.

Kinds:
- value: one number for one period.
- compare: two numbers. op is pct_change ((asked - baseline) / baseline * 100) or
  diff (asked - baseline). compare_kind says how to get the baseline.
- series: the same metric over each listed period, in that order.
- multi: the same metric and period, once per entry in multi_filters.
- trend: whether the metric is increasing or decreasing across the periods.
- argmax: the day or month with the max or min value. Ties go to the earliest date.

Period kinds. Copy numbers that are written in the question. For relative wording,
use the kind or year_rel. Never turn 'tháng này', 'tuần rồi', 'năm ngoái', or
'Tết năm nay' into calendar dates.
- day: an explicit calendar date. Example: ngày 3/3/2024 -> date 2024-03-03.
- today: hôm nay.
- yesterday: hôm qua.
- last_n_days: 7 ngày gần nhất -> n=7, including today.
- week_this: tuần này, Monday through today.
- week_last: tuần rồi / tuần trước, the previous Monday-Sunday week.
- month: tháng 5/2025 -> month=5, year=2025. tháng 5 with no year -> year null.
- month_this: tháng này, day 1 through today.
- month_last: the whole previous calendar month, not the same-day-count comparison.
- quarter: quý 3 with no year -> q=3, year null. quý 3/2024 -> q=3, year=2024.
- year: năm 2024 -> year=2024. năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. năm nay -> year_rel=0.
- ytd: từ đầu năm đến hôm nay.
- range: both endpoints are written as calendar dates.
- tet: Tết năm nay -> year_rel=0. Tết năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. Tết 2024 -> year=2024.
- before_tet: 17 ngày trước Tết năm nay -> n_days=17, year_rel=0.

compare_kind:
- explicit: the question names both periods. Asked period first, baseline second.
- previous_period: so với kỳ trước, or tháng trước cùng số ngày. One period only.
- same_period_last_year: cùng kỳ năm ngoái. One period only.
- before_tet_same_length: same number of days immediately before Tết. One period only.
- null: not a period comparison. Use filters_b when both sides share a period but
  use different filters, such as ca chiều versus ca sáng. filters is the asked side
  and filters_b is the baseline.

- doanh thu, dthu, dt = revenue. bn, bnhiu, bao nhiu = bao nhiêu. đơn = order.
- hqua = hôm qua. hnay, bữa nay = hôm nay. tm = tiền mặt. ck = chuyển khoản.
- 'tra bang Momo' is trả bằng (paid with, a payment_method), not the drink trà.
- ca sáng / ca chiều = morning / afternoon shift. tuần rồi = tuần trước = week_last.

  same_period_last_year, which needs năm (cùng kỳ năm ngoái / năm trước).
- từ đầu tháng (này) đến hôm nay = month_this. ytd only for đầu năm or 1/1.
- tăng liên tục, tăng đều, giảm dần across listed periods = trend.
- N tháng liên tiếp kết thúc ở tháng X = series of N months ending at X, oldest first.

Families:

  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.

Threshold op: set op from the question (inclusive vs exclusive). Do not invent
x; copy the written VND amount as an integer.

Period kinds match the main parser: day, today, yesterday, last_n_days, week_this,
week_last, month, month_this, month_last, quarter, year, ytd, range, tet,
before_tet. Copy written numbers; never invent calendar dates for relative words.

Families:

  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.

You translate one Vietnamese shop question into a flat JSON object.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate dates.

Metrics (the only ones in scope):
- revenue: money from orders that are completed or shipping, excluding cancelled
  orders and any order that has a return. Sum of line amounts in the period.
- order_count: number of those same orders (not cancelled, not returned).
- cancel_count: number of cancelled orders.
- cancel_rate: cancelled orders divided by all orders placed in the period, times 100.
- avg_order_value: revenue divided by order_count.
- revenue_share: revenue of the filtered part divided by revenue of the whole shop
  in the same period, times 100. Walk-in customers stay in the denominator.

Kinds:
- value: one number for one period.
- compare: two numbers. op is pct_change ((asked - baseline) / baseline * 100) or
  diff (asked - baseline). compare_kind says how to get the baseline.
- series: the same metric over each listed period, in that order.
- multi: the same metric and period, once per entry in multi_filters.
- trend: whether the metric is increasing or decreasing across the periods.
- argmax: the day or month with the max or min value. Ties go to the earliest date.

Period kinds. Copy numbers that are written in the question. For relative wording,
use the kind or year_rel. Never turn 'tháng này', 'tuần rồi', 'năm ngoái', or
'Tết năm nay' into calendar dates.
- day: an explicit calendar date. Example: ngày 3/3/2024 -> date 2024-03-03.
- today: hôm nay.
- yesterday: hôm qua.
- last_n_days: 7 ngày gần nhất -> n=7, including today.
- week_this: tuần này, Monday through today.
- week_last: tuần rồi / tuần trước, the previous Monday-Sunday week.
- month: tháng 5/2025 -> month=5, year=2025. tháng 5 with no year -> year null.
- month_this: tháng này, day 1 through today.
- month_last: the whole previous calendar month, not the same-day-count comparison.
- quarter: quý 3 with no year -> q=3, year null. quý 3/2024 -> q=3, year=2024.
- year: năm 2024 -> year=2024. năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. năm nay -> year_rel=0.
- ytd: từ đầu năm đến hôm nay.
- range: both endpoints are written as calendar dates.
- tet: Tết năm nay -> year_rel=0. Tết năm ngoái -> year_rel=-1. Tết 2024 -> year=2024.
- before_tet: 17 ngày trước Tết năm nay -> n_days=17, year_rel=0.

compare_kind:
- explicit: the question names both periods. Asked period first, baseline second.
- previous_period: so với kỳ trước, or tháng trước cùng số ngày. One period only.
- same_period_last_year: cùng kỳ năm ngoái. One period only.
- before_tet_same_length: same number of days immediately before Tết. One period only.
- null: not a period comparison. Use filters_b when both sides share a period but
  use different filters, such as ca chiều versus ca sáng. filters is the asked side
  and filters_b is the baseline.

Vietnamese wording. Questions are often typed without diacritics or abbreviated:
- doanh thu, dthu, dt = revenue. bn, bnhiu, bao nhiu = bao nhiêu. đơn = order.
- hqua = hôm qua. hnay, bữa nay = hôm nay. tm = tiền mặt. ck = chuyển khoản.
- 'tra bang Momo' is trả bằng (paid with, a payment_method), not the drink trà.
- ca sáng / ca chiều = morning / afternoon shift. tuần rồi = tuần trước = week_last.
- tháng trước, tháng trc, th truoc, tháng rồi = the previous month. 'cùng kỳ tháng
  trước' and 'so với tháng (liền) trước đó' are previous_period, never
  same_period_last_year, which needs năm (cùng kỳ năm ngoái / năm trước).
- từ đầu tháng (này) đến hôm nay = month_this. ytd only for đầu năm or 1/1.
- tăng liên tục, tăng đều, giảm dần across listed periods = trend.
- N tháng liên tiếp kết thúc ở tháng X = series of N months ending at X, oldest first.

You classify one Vietnamese shop question into a metric-family JSON.
You do not calculate the answer and you do not calculate calendar dates.

Families:
- qty_sold: how many base units of one product sold, OR how many base units sold
  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.
- top_products: best or worst selling items. k, by qty_base | revenue |
  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.

Families:

  across all products whose base unit is a named unit (hộp / gói / ...).
  Set product OR base_unit (exactly one), plus period. Optional category and
  size M|L when the shop lists them and the question names that filter.

  gross_profit, mode max|min, period. Optional category / size.
  'bán chạy' -> by=qty_base; money/doanh thu -> by=revenue; lãi/lời ->
  by=gross_profit.
- unsold_products: items sold before the period with no revenue sale inside it.
  output count|list, period. Optional category.
- products_in_min_orders: *products* in at least n distinct revenue orders.
  output count|list. Optional category.
- price_on_date: unit selling price of one product on one day. product + date
  (or a single-day period).
- price_increase_effect: percent change in qty_base after a price rise.
- customers_min_orders: customers with at least n revenue orders in the period.
  output count|share (share = percent of customers who bought in the period).
- top_customers: best or worst customers. k, by revenue | order_count, mode
  max|min, period. Money/nhiều tiền -> by=revenue; nhiều đơn -> by=order_count.
- orders_min_amount: count of revenue orders whose order revenue passes a
  money threshold. x (VND integer), op '>=' | '>' (from the question wording),
  period.
- days_min_revenue: count of days in the period whose day revenue passes x with
  op '>=' | '>'. Days with no orders never qualify.
- debt_total: remaining customer debt at end of one as-of day. Set date
  (single day / today / yesterday). output='count' when the question asks how
  many customers still owe; otherwise output null (total money owed).
- top_debtors: top k customers by remaining debt at as-of day -> table.
  Set k and date.
- debt_aging: remaining debt split into age buckets at as-of day. Set date and
  buckets as [[lo, hi], ...] with hi null for open-ended (copy bounds from the
  question order).
- debt_added: unpaid part on the order day for debt orders placed in period.
- debt_collected: later payments (after order day) dated in the period on debt
  orders. Refunds are not subtracted.
- customer_debt_flow: for one named customer, debt added and debt paid back in
  the period as two numbers. customer = the name or code copied from the question.
- purchase_total: sum of purchase receipt totals in period (cancelled excluded).
- top_supplier: supplier with the highest purchase total in period.
- avg_purchase_cost: quantity-weighted average unit cost for one product in a
  month (purchase unit). product + period.
- stock_on_hand: on-hand qty of one product at end of a day. product + date;
  optional unit (base -> number; big unit -> list [whole, leftover base]).
- stock_value: inventory value at end of day (on-hand * products.unit_cost).
- out_of_stock_count: resale products with end-of-day stock 0.
- lots_expiring: lots still in stock expiring within n_days from as-of.
  output count|list|cost. date + n_days.
- nearest_expiry_lot: earliest unexpired lot still in stock for one product.
- ingredient_revenue: revenue of products with exact active_ingredient.
- rx_share: prescription revenue / total revenue (percent).
- rx_revenue: revenue (VND) of prescription drugs in the period.
- otc_revenue: revenue (VND) of everything except prescription drugs.
- gross_profit: revenue minus qty*cost_per_unit on revenue lines.
- net_profit: gross profit minus expenses in the month/period.
- top_employee: employee with highest revenue in the period.
- employee_revenue: revenue of the orders one employee sold in the period.
  employee = the code or name copied from the question.
- none: shop-wide revenue totals, deliveries, or anything this list cannot
  express.

Count vs list vs share vs cost: how many without listing -> count; list/name ->
list; percent of customers -> share; lot cost value -> cost.
